guide.text: Increases Attack and Energy gain, allowing Cyborg to cast his Ultimate and key skills more often to keep his damage buffs rolling.
Increases Energy gain. Since The Penguin's Ultimate summons multiple explosive minions, faster Energy recovery lets him summon them more often, keeping up a constant bombardment of enemies.
Focuses on Energy gain and survivability, letting Batgirl cast her Ultimate more often and safely for ongoing crit and healing support.
Increases Energy gain. Captain Cold's Ultimate is the key to boosting the squad's physical damage, so faster Energy recovery lets him create more opportunities for the squad to strike.
Increases Energy gain. The Flash mainly channels Energy to core damage dealers, so faster Energy recovery allows him to support allies more often.

Increases Energy gain. As an attack-focused Supporter, Zatanna's Ultimate is her core bonus skill, so faster Energy recovery lets her enter the enhanced state more often and perform ranged basic attacks with her clone.

Increases Energy gain. The Joker's Ultimate has a high chance to inflict multiple stacks of [Joker Venom], which can spread to other enemies, and faster Energy recovery lets him inflict it more often, accelerating its spread.
Increases Energy gain. Black Canary's Ultimate silences enemies, which is crucial for many team strategies. Faster Energy recovery means she can disrupt enemy skills more often.
Increases Energy gain. Since Vixen's Ultimate boosts allies' Attack within a large range, faster Energy recovery lets her provide these Attack bonuses more often.

Increases Energy gain. Conner Kent's Ultimate is the key source of bonuses for [Superman Family] allies, so faster Energy recovery means he can grant more Attack bonuses and control immunity to the squad.

Increases Energy gain. Krypto's passive ability lets him sniff out buried bones to gain Energy, and the Flash-Bulb Kite further boosts his Energy gain, allowing him to heal and accumulate Krypton Energy consistently.
Increases Energy gain. Stargirl's Ultimate dispels debuffs and grants damage reduction, which is crucial against control-focused lineups, so faster Energy recovery lets her protect allies more often.
Increases base Attack and HP. A solid all-purpose choice that lets The Flash support the squad and deal damage before his Legacy Piece is ready.
Grants balanced stats such as Attack and HP, making it a solid all-purpose transitional option.
